title: Research
text:
Telehealth Parity Laws and Medicaid Enrollment
This study examines whether the adoption of telehealth parity laws affected Medicaid enrollment among low-income adults in the United States. Using a difference-in-differences design, the study compares states that adopted telehealth parity laws in 2021 with states that did not adopt such laws.
Data-generating process. The study uses American Community Survey (ACS) data from 2015–2023 for adults aged 19–64 with household income at or below 138% of the federal poverty level. The analysis constructs PUMA-year level Medicaid enrollment rates and combines them with state-level information on telehealth parity law adoption.
